status: OSW editorial crosswalk; not an official oceanographic standard
scope: Facets for named motion records. Object type, identity level, geographic setting, time behavior, and evidence are separate axes; a name alone does not establish a measured boundary or live track.

object_type.boundary_current: Current following an ocean basin margin; crosswalk OBJ019.
object_type.eddy: Rotating, finite-lived flow structure; crosswalk OBJ021.
object_type.ring: Eddy detached from a parent current; crosswalk OBJ022.

motion_form.definition: Primary physical form of an identified NASA record, separate from NASA naming support and from the identity level of any individual feature.

identity_level.family: Shared name used for related flows in more than one basin; split before measuring.
identity_level.system: A named circulation system that can contain branches or segments.
identity_level.current: One named current with a source-dependent upstream and downstream extent.
identity_level.segment: Named part or continuation of a larger current system.
identity_level.eddy_family: A named class of related eddies, such as Agulhas Rings; individual members need separate dated identities.
identity_level.recurrent_eddy_region: A geographic name reused for eddies forming or persisting in a region; not one dated individual or trajectory.
identity_level.individual_eddy: A particular named eddy, separate from its type, region, and trajectory ID.
identity_level.dated_detection: A feature designated by one provider in one dated receipt; no historical-name equivalence, formation time, lifetime, or continuity across dates is established.

setting.western_boundary: Along the western edge of an ocean basin.
setting.eastern_boundary: Along the eastern edge of an ocean basin.
setting.polar_or_subpolar_margin: High-latitude margin; boundary side needs case-specific evidence.
setting.coastal_or_shelf: Coastal or shelf-following flow without a claimed basin-boundary class.
setting.equatorial: Equatorial or tropical zonal flow; basin-specific records may be needed.
setting.basin_interior_or_extension: Open-ocean pathway or named downstream continuation.
setting.regional: Named regional flow whose finer setting has not been established here.
setting.gulf_of_mexico: Regional locator for named Loop Current rings; not an eddy centroid.

time_behavior.persistent_variable: Recognizable over years, with a shifting path and strength.
time_behavior.seasonally_reversing: Direction changes with the seasonal circulation.
time_behavior.recurrent: A named regional eddy form appears repeatedly or quasi-persistently; individual generations need dated IDs.
time_behavior.unresolved: The naming source does not establish a temporal class.

vertical_setting.surface_expression: A named flow with a documented surface expression; its core may extend below the surface.
vertical_setting.subsurface_core: A named flow whose defining core is below the surface; a geographic movie tile alone does not verify it visually.
vertical_setting.deep_flow: A named flow primarily at deep or bottom depths; surface views are not evidence for its position.
vertical_setting.unresolved: The source does not establish a depth setting.

polarity.cyclonic: Rotation in the local cyclonic sense; requires detection or source evidence.
polarity.anticyclonic: Rotation in the local anticyclonic sense; requires detection or source evidence.
polarity.unresolved: Not inferred from a name, map symbol, or core temperature.

core_thermal_sign.warm: Warmer core relative to nearby water, in a specified observation product.
core_thermal_sign.cold: Colder core relative to nearby water, in a specified observation product.
core_thermal_sign.unresolved: Polarity and temperature are independent claims.

location_evidence.editorial_locator: Approximate place to find the named flow on an atlas; no boundary or centroid claim.
location_evidence.source_region_only: Source supports the region, not a position for the individual eddy.
location_evidence.observed_track: Dated positions from a named observation or tracking product.

admission_rules: Keep official source terms and OSW editorial labels distinguishable.
Every individual eddy needs a naming source; a track ID needs its own product and identifier.
Do not infer eddy polarity, core temperature, footprint, or live status from a name.
Do not use a locator point to calculate a current length or claim an eddy position.
A video showing particles is not a feature boundary or a global name register.

source_scoped_regime_vocabularies.label: Antarctic shelf/slope hydrographic regimes (Thompson et al., 2018)
source_scoped_regime_vocabularies.scope: Regional shelf/slope hydrographic regimes in this review, not a whole-current permanent class or global eddy taxonomy

terms.criterion_summary: Layers with neutral density gamma_n greater than 28.0 (source-reported kg/m3 scale) do not extend onto the shelf.
Water with neutral density gamma_n greater than 28.0 (source-reported kg/m3 scale) occupies the shelf, which stays relatively cold with convection and dense-water formation.
Water with neutral density gamma_n greater than 28.0 reaches the shelf without dense-water formation; shelf water exceeds 0.5 degrees Celsius at some shelf depth.

source_scoped_regime_vocabularies.density_variable_note: Thresholds refer to the source's neutral-density variable gamma_n in its conventional reported units, not an absolute seawater mass density of 28 kg/m3.
assignment_requirements: Explicit unknown or mixed regime where support is insufficient
source_scoped_regime_vocabularies.method: OSW paraphrase of the cited source classification; criteria describe regional hydrographic support, not observed assignments or automatic surface-image classification
